Check the new virtue rank afterwards. Each activity uses the afternoon; do not try to do both.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: At the Hushed Honeybee Inn in Grand Trad's Sunshade Row, speak to Fabienne while Maria is present and choose the help option, “Let's do it, then”. Do not select the named Redgrass-Roasted Bidou dish. Follow the prompt for the dish she gives you and confirm Chef in Training afterwards. Maria needs at least rank 2; this event must be done before October.

steps.label: Reminder for tomorrow · no extra activity tonight
steps.text: Keep tonight's cooking trophy event completed on your save. If Wisdom or Imagination is still below 4, tomorrow's entry replaces the blocked bond event with a virtue activity. You do not need to fix both ranks tonight. Reloading after the cooking trophy would undo that activity on your save.

steps.label: Free check · before today's activities
steps.text: Visit More and report any task you have already completed, then check your actual Wisdom and Imagination ranks for the choices below.
items: Ongoing goals: General rank 15, studying 25 different Archetypes, and mastering one Elite Archetype at rank 20 are separate More tasks. Report them in that order as you finish them during your playthrough. None is an instruction to stop and train today.

After Hulkenberg's rank-7 event, if you can take it today, you may check the study list again because her bond opens further options. Only count the Imagination reward once you have completed and reported its task. Leave unfinished tasks active and use the stated virtue alternatives below if needed.

steps.label: Afternoon · choose ONE activity
items: Wisdom 4 or higher: Use Followers to meet Hulkenberg in town and complete rank 7.
Wisdom below 4: Use View of the Beach near the runner on Virga Island's Sandy Coast to raise Wisdom.
Reminder for later, only if you delayed her bond: Record Hulkenberg rank 7 for 2 October afternoon, then rank 8 for the 6 October journey. Her 27 August runner event requires town rank 7 first.

steps.label: Night · choose ONE activity
items: Imagination 4 or higher: Use Followers to meet Heismay in town and complete rank 7.
Imagination below 4: Teleport to Brilehaven → Angler's Inn Square and listen to the Sanctor's story to raise Imagination.
Reminder for later, only if you delayed his bond: Record Heismay rank 7 for 2 October night, then rank 8 for the 6 October journey.

steps.label: Afternoon · travel and cooking catch-up
steps.text: Set Orbwise Path as your destination. Once the runner is moving, visit the kitchen before meditating.
items: If you skipped Precision Fermented Ribs on 1 August, make it now: Fiendflower Nectar ×1, Giant's Rib ×1 and Marbled Bluefin Tuna ×2.
If you already cooked it, skip this recipe. You may instead make one other unfinished dish if you have its ingredients.
If supplies are still missing, note what you lack and continue to today's meditation below. Speed Cooking lets you cook one dish before that activity.

steps.label: Afternoon · travel, then dungeon
steps.text: Meditate with Eupha on the journey to Orbwise Path and choose “Breathe deeply.”
items: On arrival, collect both Gold Beetles: one on the ground floor in the large room with two chests, and one on the upper floor reached by the stairs. Defeat the quest target to finish Save the Mourning Snakes and unlock Junah's bond.

steps.label: After the dungeon
steps.text: Choose to camp here, then choose to continue onward tomorrow toward Silento and Spire of Blind Faith. Stay on this journey and do tonight's Neuras event below. Returning to town would disrupt the next three dates.

steps.label: Night · main activity
steps.text: Give Neuras the Mossy Pillar relic you collected in Land of Ceremony on 22 August to reach bond rank 4. That finishes today's scheduled activities. When the date advances, open the matching next date in the guide; you have no extra dungeon or training task tonight.

steps.label: Cooking catch-up · before each main activity
steps.text: With Speed Cooking, you can make ONE dish before today's meditation and ONE before tonight's activity. Choose a dish using this order; skip cooking if you do not have its ingredients.
items: First priority, if The Queen of Cuisine: Heart is still unfinished: Make Benevolent Bread using Fragrant Spice ×1, Mellow Milk ×1 and Orgo Sugar ×1. Keep one serving for the Classy Woman's later hand-in.

Otherwise, check for an uncooked recipe you can make. Start with Magical Bread or Invincible Noodles if either is unfinished. Magical Bread needs Mora Coney Meat ×2, Rockbeans ×2 and Dreameater Moth ×1. Invincible Noodles needs Fragrant Spice ×1, Bidou Meat ×2 and Lumibee ×1.
At night, check the glowing campfire pickup before choosing the evening's dish. Its bug is random, so you may still lack the moth or Lumibee.

Ongoing goal: Keep a list of any dishes still uncooked and their missing ingredients. You can continue cooking on later journeys. Do not replace today's meditation or tonight's activity with extra cooking.

steps.label: Afternoon · main activity
steps.text: Continue the journey and meditate with Eupha. Choose the response about focusing on numbness.
items: At Silento, open the village shop before continuing the route. Passing the map marker alone does not count as the shop visit. This visit counts toward the village list checked on 20 October.

steps.label: Night · choose ONE activity, using the first option that matches
items: Imagination below 4: Reread New World Travel Diary.
Imagination at least 4, but Wisdom below 4: Reread The Magical Future.
Both virtues at least 4: Listen to Junah sing on the runner for Eloquence.
Reminder for later: Raising a virtue does not complete a missed town bond event. Keep the 2 October booking if you still need Hulkenberg or Heismay rank 7.

steps.label: Afternoon · choose ONE travel activity
items: Hulkenberg's town rank 7 is complete: Take her travelling rank-8 bond event.
Her rank 7 is still pending: Reread The Magical Future for Wisdom. Her rank-7 event requires a town visit; keep it booked for 2 October.
During this route, receive the Sporico Cave drawing.

steps.label: Night · choose ONE travel activity
items: Heismay's town rank 7 is complete: Take his travelling rank-8 bond event.
His rank 7 is still pending: Reread New World Travel Diary for Imagination. Keep his town event booked for 2 October.

steps.label: Reminder for later · no extra activity today
steps.text: If either bond is unfinished, record town rank 7 and travelling rank 8 as separate events. The recovery entries use 2 October in town, then 6 October while travelling: Hulkenberg in the afternoon and Heismay at night. You still need the relevant virtue rank before taking the town event.

steps.label: Afternoon · travel, then dungeon
steps.text: Reread The Magical Future while travelling to Spire of Blind Faith.
items: At the entrance, speak to the Confident Woman for Peak Curiosity before climbing the tower.
Clear the tower and collect its Gold Beetle on the sixth floor. Defeat Leogron to obtain the Monster Notebook.
Before returning to town, give the Monster Notebook to the Confident Woman at the entrance. Tomorrow's village hand-in needs this conversation completed today.

steps.label: Reminder for 30 August · no battle or level target today
steps.text: Bardon's planned event includes a level-60 boss. Save before attempting that event on 30 August. If your team struggles then, the guide offers a different activity that day and moves his battle to 16 October, followed by his final bond on 18 October. You do not need to grind to a specific level before leaving today's dungeon.
items: Reference: the original route suggests about level 57 for your main damage dealers. If you want to try on 30 August and are well below that, the top floor before this dungeon's boss is a good repeatable spot. Optional; the 16 October fallback remains.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Used by the dungeon. Return and rest.

steps.label: Free hand-in · Virga Island
steps.text: Speak to the Dejected Man outside Rooster Inn to complete Peak Curiosity. Yesterday's Monster Notebook must already have been given to the Confident Woman at the spire entrance. Optional discounted shopping and MAG exchange can follow; keep a reserve for Archetype studies.
items: If The Queen of Cuisine: Heart is still active and you have Benevolent Bread, teleport to Martira → Thoroughfare Square → Visca Alba Tavern. Give the bread to the Classy Woman inside near the guest-room door, then continue today's events.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Find Eupha through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 2.

steps.label: Night · main activity
steps.text: Meet Alonzo in Brilehaven → Angler's Inn Square and take the event matching his current bond rank.
items: Already rank 4: Take rank 5 tonight.

Still rank 3 because his rank-2 event moved to 10 August: Check Tolerance 3 and take rank 4 tonight. Record rank 5 for 1 September night and rank 6 for 4 September afternoon; those are later activities.

steps.label: Afternoon · attempt Bardon's event OR use the recovery activity
steps.text: Save before speaking to Bardon for The Right to Rule. His rank-7 event includes a level-60 boss.
items: If you win, finish the event and continue to tonight's Junah event. You have no second afternoon activity.

If the battle is too difficult, reload your pre-event save and leave The Right to Rule active. Use ONE activity instead: View of the Beach on Virga Island if Wisdom is below 4; otherwise the Sanctor's story in Brilehaven → Angler's Inn Square for Imagination.
Reminder for later, only if you postponed the battle: The recovery entries schedule Bardon rank 7 on 16 October and rank 8 on 18 October. You do not need to stay here and grind today.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: Find Junah through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 2.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Find Eupha through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 3.

steps.label: Night · choose one activity · uses time
steps.text: Check Alonzo's current follower rank, then follow the matching option.
items: Alonzo is rank 4 after the August recovery: use Followers to find him in Brilehaven and complete rank 5 tonight.
Otherwise: go to the Coliseum at Brilehaven's Arenafront Wharf and win the next ranked match available to you. Record the rank you won so later arena instructions follow your actual progress.

steps.label: Afternoon · choose one activity · uses time
steps.text: Check when you completed Alonzo rank 5.
items: Completed on 29 August: take his daytime rank-6 event today.

Completed last night: go to the Sanctor in Brilehaven's Angler's Inn Square and listen to his story for Imagination today. Leave Alonzo's next event for 4 September afternoon; he needs the intervening day between events.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: Find Junah through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 3.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Meet Eupha in town for rank 4, following rank 3 on 1 September. Keep this date even in Alonzo’s Wisdom-recovery branch.

steps.label: Night · one arena challenge · uses time
steps.text: Go to the Coliseum at Brilehaven's Arenafront Wharf. Before committing to a challenge, choose your next ranked match if your party is ready, or an easier endurance challenge for Courage instead.
items: If you choose endurance, do only that challenge tonight. Leave the ranked fight unfinished for October. An endurance win does not advance your ranked ladder.

Reminder for later: Alonzo rank 7 needs Courage 5. Check your current virtue rank after tonight's reward, but do not add a second activity tonight. If you postponed arena sessions, their expected Courage rewards are still missing.

steps.label: Before departure · free errand · Sandy Coast, Virga Island
steps.text: Find the Hearty Shopkeep beside the Village Butcher on the bridge. Pay 250 reeve and try the local food challenge for Tail Bait if you have not already collected that reward. Keep the bait for 07 September.

steps.label: Afternoon · choose one activity
steps.text: Check whether Alonzo rank 5 moved to 1 September.
items: If it did: meet him in Brilehaven's Angler's Inn Square for rank 6 today. Stay in town and skip the runner outing below.

Otherwise, take the optional runner outing: select a route toward Inundo that intercepts Jin's runner. Check the encounter marker and active party before leaving. Meditate with Eupha while travelling. If this is your fourth meditation, following 21, 25 and 26 August, choose “A burning fire.” Complete the encounter and return to town for tonight's bond.
Reminder for later: this outing is self-contained. A later request may send you back to this runner; that trip is scheduled separately.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: Find Junah through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 4.

steps.label: Free shopping, then afternoon bond
steps.text: In Virga Island's Dragon Statue Plaza, visit Krozelli Hunter, the Boastful Shopkeeper, before choosing your activity.
items: Shopping: compare his talismans with Akademeia's Special Experiments list. Buy missing materials within your budget.
Afternoon · uses time: take Eupha's bond event to rank 5.
Ongoing goal: you still need to make the vessels in Akademeia. Buying their materials does not count as making them, but you are not required to finish the collection today.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Story.

steps.label: To do
steps.text: Follow the story. Choose whichever companion you prefer for the evening event. Its equipment reward is optional; no repeated runs are needed to collect every version for the platinum.

steps.label: Optional ongoing goal · Gallica conversations
steps.text: During the quiet inn opportunity, you can speak to Gallica if you still need progress toward 100 conversations. You do not need to reach 100 today; continue the story when ready.

steps.label: Afternoon · fishing · uses time
steps.text: Go to the fishing point on the runner's deck and select Tail Bait. Match your answer to Heismay's comment:
items: Queasy: choose “Think like a fish”. Tired: choose “Give in to naptime”. Nothing biting: choose “Thrash and splash”.
Check that you receive 1 Lord of the Lake and 2 Queen's Honey Jars.
Keep this fish for Enchanted Pottage and the honey for cooking.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: Speak to Eupha in the runner's lounge and reminisce for Imagination.

steps.label: Afternoon · reading · uses time
steps.text: Read the first session of How to Walk Outside the Island. You will also receive the route drawing during the journey.

steps.label: Night · reading · uses time
steps.text: Read the second session of How to Walk Outside the Island.

steps.label: Afternoon · reading · uses time
steps.text: Read the third session of How to Walk Outside the Island to finish the book. Receive the next route drawing during the journey.
items: Check after the reward: note your Tolerance rank. Catherina's rank-6 event on 16 September needs Tolerance 5; reaching it is not a requirement to leave this journey today, and the book does not guarantee it. If you are still below 5, use the Tolerance alternative on the relevant later date.

steps.label: Evening · free collection · Altabury
steps.text: Collect the five Gold Beetles below, then go to Skyward Tavern, the inn on Dia Franco Street.
items: Lunlumo Approach: one by a tree on the southeast pavement, and another down the stairs in the northeast.
Lower Blue Sky Bridge: inside a pot in Whitepeaks Magic Shop, which opens at night.
Upper Blue Sky Bridge: behind a pillar between Cielaroko Armsmith and Snowflower Pharmacy.
Opera House Square: near the guard at the northeast end of the bridge.

steps.label: Before the required destination
steps.text: Do any shopping the story allows before going to the Opera House. The Skyward Tavern Gold Beetle is scheduled during the free errands on 13 September.

steps.label: To do
steps.text: Follow the Opera House objective and story. Do not assume an extra toilet visit or free activity is possible today.

steps.label: Story day
steps.text: Follow the main objective. No separate free-time activity is scheduled; continue until the game advances the date.

steps.label: Story day
steps.text: Follow the main objective. No separate free-time activity is scheduled; continue until the game advances the date.

steps.label: Keep a start-of-day save
steps.text: Today's debate and short trip share a tight schedule. Read this day's instructions before committing to travel. Before leaving Skyward Tavern, collect the Gold Beetle behind the barrels in the corner of the main room if you have not already picked it up.

steps.label: Free conversations · Dia Franco Street, Altabury
steps.text: Speak to Loveless and Rudolf outside Skyward Tavern so their runners appear on the map.

steps.label: Free requests · Altabury
steps.text: On Dia Franco Street, speak to the Portly Man beside Loveless outside Skyward Tavern and accept Warmth in Winter. In Opera House Square, speak to the Obsessive Soldier beside the foot of the stairs near the entrance and accept Proof of Power.

steps.label: Free preparation
steps.text: In Altabury, use the Mountain Recruitment Centre on Lunlumo Approach to accept The Fiend in the Frozen Forest, the Icebeast Chimenzahn bounty. Buy the Tower of Insolence location report from the informant in Skyward Tavern on Dia Franco Street. On Lower Blue Sky Bridge, give a Medicinal Herb to the Man in Pain outside Whitepeaks Magic Shop; keep the Tail Bait.

steps.label: Before departure · free shopping
steps.text: Buy only what you need to reach the quantities below. These are amounts to have in your inventory, not extra amounts to buy.
items: Altabury → Upper Dia Franco Street → Dedicated Butcher / Korno Meat Market: have 1 Brocaded Koi and 2 Monster Bones.
On the same street, visit Aurelia Water Shop: have 2 Orgo Sugar.

If Finisher Noodles is still unfinished, increase your targets at Korno Meat Market to 2 Brocaded Koi and 3 Monster Bones. Also buy enough Pristine Clearwater at Aurelia Water Shop to hold 3. The extra fish, bone and water are for those noodles.
Grand Trad → Regalith Grand Cathedral market → Herb-Seller: have 3 Redgrass.
Virga Island → Sandy Coast → Village Butcher / Graco Meat Market: have 2 White Peach Turnips. Use town-to-town fast travel for these shopping stops, then return to Altabury.
Check your rare ingredients: 1 Lord of the Lake, 5 Queen's Honey Jars and 2 Lumibees. The five honey cover today's stew, a later cake and the final recipe.

If short on honey, check Amblyrhy's Water Jug on Virga Island's Sandy Coast for remaining stock. If a rare ingredient is still missing, continue today's trip and bond; leave the affected recipe for a later journey.

steps.label: Afternoon · route
steps.text: Set out toward Malva on a route that meets Loveless' runner. Check the encounter marker before confirming the route.

steps.label: While travelling · cooking, then bond
steps.text: Visit the runner's kitchen before choosing Basilio's bond event.
items: Cook Amber Stew with 1 Brocaded Koi, 1 Queen's Honey Jar and 3 Redgrass. Speed Cooking leaves your main activity available.
If an ingredient is missing, skip this dish for now. Keep today's bond event.
Take Basilio's first bond event on the runner, then complete the Loveless encounter on the route.

steps.label: Village stop · Malva
steps.text: Open the village shop before returning to Altabury.
items: Buy Durable Spider Silk for Warmth in Winter.
Buy enough Altabury Wheat Flour to hold 4: 1 for tomorrow's pottage, 2 for Indestructible Honey Cake on 17 September and 1 for Adamantine Honey Cake on 18 September.
This visit counts toward the village list checked on 20 October. Return to Altabury.

steps.label: Night · free hand-in
steps.text: Return the Durable Spider Silk to the Portly Man outside Skyward Tavern on Dia Franco Street. Speak to Loveless there to accept Defeat Milo. Then speak to Milo by the Mountain Recruitment Centre on Lunlumo Approach to reveal his runner.

steps.label: Night · uses time, priority
steps.text: Go to the podium on Upper Blue Sky Bridge and debate Julian. Choose “The present day matters too.” Confirm the debate trophy if all seven earlier debates were wins.

steps.label: Debate check · no extra activity
steps.text: Keep this morning's save until you have won Julian's debate. His scheduled appearance is tonight, after returning from Malva.
items: If he is absent, confirm that the game says 13 September at night and that you are at the Upper Blue Sky Bridge podium. Do not spend the night on something else yet.

Fallback: Game8 lists Julian at this podium on later Flamesday, Arboursday and Metalsday nights until 25 October; record the debate as pending and take it on the next such free night. One trophy guide shows a 13 September afternoon appearance instead; to settle it today, reload this morning's save, debate him this afternoon, and move the Malva trip and its hand-ins to 14 September.

steps.label: Reminder for later · check ranks only
steps.text: Open Royal Virtues and note your current ranks. Do not spend an extra activity tonight trying to reach all the targets below.
items: 15 September: Junah needs Imagination 4.
16 September: Eupha needs Eloquence 4; Catherina needs Tolerance 5.
17 September: Alonzo needs Courage 5.
26 September: Basilio needs Imagination 5. Literacy Workbook's third reading on 21 September supplies its completion reward before that check.

These are future requirements, not promises that you have reached them. Keep your save; if a requirement is still missing on its date, follow that day's alternative instead of marking the bond complete.

steps.label: Afternoon · travel, cook, then read
steps.text: Set a route that intercepts Milo's runner.
items: Once travelling, cook Enchanted Pottage with 1 Altabury Wheat Flour, 2 Monster Bones and 1 Lord of the Lake. This uses the fish saved from 7 September.
If ingredients are missing, leave this dish for a later journey and keep today's reading.
Read Literacy Workbook for the first time. Complete the Milo encounter and return for tonight's hand-in.

steps.label: Night · free hand-in first
steps.text: Return to Loveless outside Skyward Tavern on Dia Franco Street, Altabury, and report Defeat Milo before taking tonight's bond.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: Find Catherina through Followers and take her rank 5 bond event.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Find Basilio through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 2.

steps.label: Night · choose one activity · uses time
steps.text: Check Imagination before choosing an activity.
items: Imagination 4 or higher: take Junah's nighttime rank-5 event.
Below Imagination 4: listen to the Chipper Old Woman outside Skyward Tavern on Altabury's Lower Dia Franco Street instead.

After the old woman's story, check Imagination again. If it has reached 4, take Junah rank 5 tomorrow night; her travelling rank 6 stays on 18 September. Those are later activities, not extra tasks tonight.
If it is still below 4, keep your save and stop before advancing the date. This fallback allows one Imagination activity; an additional shortfall needs a revised schedule.

steps.label: Afternoon · choose one activity · uses time
steps.text: Check Eloquence before choosing an activity.
items: Eloquence 4 or higher: take Eupha's rank-6 event and accept The Wayward Shepherd today.

Below Eloquence 4: give a speech at Altabury's Upper Blue Sky Bridge podium instead. Check Eloquence after the speech. If it is still below 4, keep your save and stop before advancing; the fallback below needs rank 4.

Later schedule, only if today's speech reached Eloquence 4: take Eupha rank 6 on 19 September. Basilio moves to rank 4 on 22 September, rank 5 on 26 September, rank 6 on 28 September and rank 7 on 30 September. His rank-8 check is 2 October, with 14 October reserved if needed. Petty Thief moves to 3 October.

Requirements for that later schedule: reach Imagination 5 by 28 September and Eloquence 5 by 14 October. The 26 September afternoon is already occupied by Basilio, so you cannot also use its snowcat activity. These are future requirements; do not try to complete them this afternoon.

steps.label: Night · choose the first applicable option · uses time
steps.text: Complete only one of these activities tonight.
items: Junah rank 5 was delayed yesterday and Imagination is now at least 4: take Junah rank 5. Leave Catherina for the following dated entries.
Otherwise, if Tolerance is at least 5: take Catherina rank 6.
Otherwise: speak to the Maskless Mustari on Altabury's Lower Blue Sky Bridge for Tolerance. Check your new rank after the activity. Do not try to fit Catherina's event into the same night.

steps.label: Afternoon · travel, cook, then bond
steps.text: Set a route that intercepts Rudolf's runner. Visit the kitchen before choosing the bond event.
items: Cook Indestructible Honey Cake with 2 White Peach Turnips, 2 Altabury Wheat Flour and 2 Lumibees. Keep at least 1 finished cake for the request hand-in on 26 September.
If Lumibees are missing, skip the cake today. You can buy them on 26 September and cook it during the next journey.
Take Basilio's travelling bond event to rank 3. Complete the Rudolf encounter and return to town. Then follow the separate nighttime choice below.

steps.label: Night · choose the first applicable activity · uses time
steps.text: Complete only one activity tonight.
items: Catherina rank 6 is unfinished and Tolerance is at least 5: take her rank-6 event.

Catherina rank 6 is unfinished and Tolerance is below 5: spend tonight with the Maskless Mustari on Altabury's Lower Blue Sky Bridge. Check your new rank; the 19 September Catherina fallback requires Tolerance 5.
Catherina rank 6 is complete and Courage is at least 5: take Alonzo rank 7.

Catherina rank 6 is complete but Courage is below 5: do one available Coliseum challenge for Courage. Choose the next ranked fight if your party can handle it; otherwise use an easier endurance challenge. Only a ranked victory advances the ranked ladder.
Reminder for later: any unfinished Alonzo event moves to 22 September or the reserved October nights. Do not take a second event tonight.

steps.label: Afternoon · travel, cook, then bond
steps.text: Travel to Everfrost Forest. Visit the kitchen before choosing Junah's bond event.
items: Cook Adamantine Honey Cake with 1 Altabury Wheat Flour, 1 Queen's Honey Jar and 2 Orgo Sugar. Keep 3 honey for Sublime Spoonful.
If ingredients are missing, skip the cake for now and continue today's bond and dungeon.
Take Junah's travelling bond event to rank 6, provided her rank 5 is complete.

Receive the route drawing. At Everfrost Forest, defeat Icebeast Chimenzahn. Collect the Panhandled Ore relic from the chest on the east side of the map and the Gold Beetle in the southwest corner before returning.

steps.label: Ongoing cooking goal · no extra activity today
steps.text: Sublime Spoonful appears after you have cooked the other 20 different runner dishes. You do not need to finish that collection before leaving today's dungeon.
items: On the next journey, check the kitchen menu for recipes without a cooked checkmark and note the ingredients they need.
The next scheduled cooking opportunities are 20 and 21 September, before each day's reading. With Speed Cooking, make one unfinished dish for which you have ingredients, then continue the reading.
You can cook once in each available daytime or night period. Finish the other 20 dishes before attempting Sublime Spoonful; do not add an unscheduled journey just to finish them today.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Used by the dungeon.

steps.label: Free hand-in · Recruitment Centre
steps.text: At Grand Trad's Regalith Grand Cathedral market, enter the Recruitment Centre and claim The Fiend in the Frozen Forest reward for defeating Icebeast Chimenzahn.

steps.label: Afternoon · choose one bond · uses time
steps.text: Check whether Eupha rank 6 was postponed on 16 September.
items: If it was, and Eloquence is now at least 4: take Eupha rank 6 and accept The Wayward Shepherd today. Basilio rank 4 moves to 22 September.
Otherwise, follow the normal route: take Basilio rank 4 today. Do not try to complete both bonds this afternoon.

steps.label: Night · one bond · uses time
steps.text: Check Catherina's current follower rank.
items: Rank 6, completed on 16 or 17 September: take rank 7 tonight.
Still rank 5 after the 17 September Tolerance activity: if Tolerance is now at least 5, take rank 6 tonight. Rank 7 then moves to 22 September.
Reminder for later: rank 8 remains scheduled for 3 October, after rank 7. Do not attempt two ranks tonight.

steps.label: Afternoon · travel, optional cooking, then read
steps.text: Use town travel to return to Grand Trad. In the runner's Strategy Room, select Scoundrel's Hold via Ligno.
items: Cooking catch-up, only if needed: before reading, use Speed Cooking for one unfinished dish for which you already have ingredients. Otherwise skip cooking today.
Read the second session of Literacy Workbook while travelling.
At Ligno, open the village shop before continuing; it counts toward the village list checked on 20 October. You will still have tonight's activity on the runner; follow the Neuras step below.

steps.label: Night · relic report
steps.text: Speak to Neuras on the runner and give him the Panhandled Ore relic from Everfrost Forest. Complete the report and check that his follower rank reaches 5.
items: If Neuras does not accept the Panhandled Ore tonight, keep it. Give him the Parquet Chest relic after 21 September first, then the Ore on the next free night, and check rank 7 is still reachable before 30 September.

steps.label: Afternoon · travel, then dungeon
steps.text: Complete these in order on the way to Scoundrel's Hold.
items: Cooking catch-up, only if needed: before reading, use Speed Cooking for one unfinished dish for which you have ingredients. Otherwise continue to the book.

Read the third session of Literacy Workbook to finish it. Check for the book trophy if this completes all seven books. Its Imagination reward helps with the later Basilio requirement; check your actual virtue rank rather than assuming the reward reaches it.
At Scoundrel's Hold, defeat Psyocropos. Collect the Parquet Chest relic and Gold Beetle before returning. The relic is in the northwest part of the first floor, through a crawlspace.
Reminder for later: the next scheduled Wisdom reading is The Magical Future on 27 September. Do not add that reading to today's trip.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Used by the dungeon.

steps.label: Free hand-in · Recruitment Centre
steps.text: Return to the Recruitment Centre in Grand Trad's Regalith Grand Cathedral market and claim The Greater One-Eyed Scoundrel reward for defeating Psyocropos.

steps.label: Afternoon · one bond · uses time
steps.text: Check Basilio's current follower rank, then take the next event.
items: Normally he is rank 4: take rank 5 today.
If Eupha used the 19 September afternoon and Basilio is still rank 3: take rank 4 today. Leave rank 5 for 26 September; do not attempt both today.

steps.label: Night · choose the first applicable activity · uses time
steps.text: Complete only one activity tonight.
items: Catherina reached rank 6 on 19 September: take her rank-7 event. Her rank 8 remains scheduled for 3 October.
Otherwise, Alonzo is rank 6 and Courage is at least 5: take his rank-7 event.

Otherwise, Alonzo is rank 7: go to Alonzo's usual spot in Brilehaven's Angler's Inn Square for rank 8. Guides differ on whether Alonzo or Daturam starts it; talk to whichever shows the rank-up icon. There must be a full intervening day since Alonzo's last event.
If Courage still blocks Alonzo rank 7: do one available Coliseum challenge for Courage. Record a ranked win only if you chose and won a ranked match.
Reminder for later: leave any remaining Alonzo events for the reserved October nights. This step does not ask you to finish his whole bond tonight.

steps.label: Story day
steps.text: Follow the main objective. No separate free-time activity is scheduled; continue until the game advances the date.

steps.label: During the story visit · Plaza of Light
steps.text: At the first fork, take the northeast/right branch into the dead end. Look behind the fallen roof for the Gold Beetle. Collect it before continuing the story, and keep your manual save until it is in your inventory; this visit is not freely repeatable.

steps.label: To do
steps.text: Keep a manual save before the final conversation. Choose to continue the journey. If an answer cuts the adventure short, reload that save.

steps.label: Story day
steps.text: Follow the main objective. No separate free-time activity is scheduled; continue until the game advances the date.

steps.label: Free requests · Grand Trad
steps.text: Accept these requests before spending your afternoon. Do the hand-ins today only if you already have the required food.
items: Sunshade Row: speak to the Ornamented Man outside Spado Smithy and accept The Edge of Glory.
Sunlumeo Street: speak to the Classy Woman outside Nau Filono Tavern and accept The Queen of Cuisine: Soul. Her earlier Heart request must be complete.
If you already have Indestructible Honey Cake: speak to her again and hand it over. Keep the Lord of the Lake reward for Sublime Spoonful.

If Soul is active but the cake is missing: leave the hand-in unfinished today. Cook the cake on tomorrow's journey and hand it in during the free errands on 28 September. Sublime Spoonful can use a later journey.

If Soul is unavailable because Heart is still active: give Benevolent Bread to the Classy Woman in Martira's Visca Alba Tavern, if you already have it. If the bread also needs cooking, leave that work for the next journey. Finish Heart before relying on the Soul request or its reward fish.

steps.label: Free request · Angler's Inn Square, Brilehaven
steps.text: Speak to the Gabby Mustari north of The Greatest Catch tavern to accept Trial of the Dragon: Mad Mischief.

steps.label: Free request · Dragon Statue Plaza, Virga Island
steps.text: Speak to Edeni to accept Trial of the Dragon: Heroes' Rest.

steps.label: Free requests · Upper Blue Sky Bridge, Altabury
steps.text: Speak to the Enraged Mustari by the southeast carriage for Trial of the Dragon: Bygone Legacy. Speak to the Gentle Merchant outside Snowflower Pharmacy for Deliver Hot Spring Water. Accepting the trials is free; their battles are scheduled later.

steps.label: Free bounty preparation · Grand Trad
steps.text: Enter the Recruitment Centre in the Regalith Grand Cathedral market and accept all three bounties below. You are accepting them today; their dungeon trips come later.
items: The Incarnate in the Woods: Ordemos at Abandoned Path.
The Apostles of the Apocalypse: Cistus at Disgraced Ruins.
The Cockatrice in the Clouds: Kokamordos at Manor of the Ascendant.

Accepting these bounties adds their destinations to the runner map. Confirm all three quests are active, then continue today's town activities. Their dungeon visits come on later dates. You do not need to buy a location report for these three bounties; informant reports provide optional battle advice.

steps.label: Free collection · earlier towns
steps.text: If not already collected, recheck the Grand Trad market beetle and Martira's Cattleracket Road beetle. In Martira, inspect the sack in MesmerEyes Apothecary for the later beetle. Keep a note of which pickups you actually found.

steps.label: Free shopping · prepare ingredients, do not cook yet
steps.text: Check which dishes remain uncooked, then buy only the missing quantities.
items: Comfort Concoctions, Grand Trad's Sunshade Row: buy any Lumibees or Dreameater Moths needed by your unfinished dishes.

If Indestructible Honey Cake is unfinished, have 2 White Peach Turnips, 2 Altabury Wheat Flour and 2 Lumibees ready for tomorrow's journey. In Grand Trad's Regalith Grand Cathedral market, buy turnips from the Burly Butcher and flour from the Water Merchant.
Ongoing goal: set aside 1 Lord of the Lake, 3 Queen's Honey Jars and 3 Gauntlet Shrooms for Sublime Spoonful. Add any separate ingredients needed by your other unfinished dishes.
If your Lord of the Lake will come from the Classy Woman's cake reward, it is still pending until you hand in the cake. You cannot count that fish as an ingredient already in your inventory.

steps.label: Afternoon · choose one activity · uses time
steps.text: Check Basilio's follower rank and your Imagination, then follow one option.
items: Basilio is rank 4 because of the earlier Eloquence recovery: take rank 5 today. This afternoon is already used; you cannot also make a snowcat. His next event, on 28 September, needs Imagination 5. Check again before that event. If you are still below 5 then, preserve your save and revise the schedule before proceeding; the snowcat fallback below does not also fit this branch.
Basilio is rank 5 and Imagination is at least 5: take Basilio rank 6 through Followers today.

Basilio is rank 5 but Imagination is below 5: go to Altabury's Opera House Square and make a snowcat with the Clumsy Man instead. Choose “Small and slender”, “Triangular ears”, then “We need hyper-realism”. Check your resulting Imagination rank.

After the snowcat, if Imagination has reached 5: leave Basilio rank 6 for 28 September, rank 7 for 30 September, and Neuras' Jin trip for 3 October. Check Basilio rank 8 on 2 October; 14 October is the reserved fallback. These are later appointments, not extra activities today.
If the snowcat still leaves you below Imagination 5, keep your save and stop at this checkpoint. Another activity and its later date changes need planning from your actual progress.

steps.label: Night · free follow-up
steps.text: If Alonzo is already rank 8, speak to Daturam in Brilehaven’s Angler’s Inn Square tonight for the separate free request follow-up. Do this before the hot-spring activity. If rank 8 is delayed, leave the follow-up pending until a later town night after rank 8; do not mark the request complete now.

steps.label: Night · uses time · Lower Blue Sky Bridge, Altabury
steps.text: Enter the hot springs opposite Catherina for Deliver Hot Spring Water. Complete shopping and any optional MAG exchange before entering. Tomorrow you will take the water to the Gentle Merchant outside Snowflower Pharmacy on Upper Blue Sky Bridge.

steps.label: Free hand-in · Upper Blue Sky Bridge, Altabury
steps.text: Give the hot spring water to the Gentle Merchant outside Snowflower Pharmacy and collect the Gold Beetle reward.

steps.label: Afternoon · travel, one dish if needed, then read
steps.text: Select Mt. Vulkano on the runner map. Once travelling, visit the kitchen before reading.
items: If Sublime Spoonful is unlocked and you have 1 Lord of the Lake, 3 Queen's Honey Jars and 3 Gauntlet Shrooms: use Speed Cooking to make it. Check for the cooking trophy.
Otherwise, cook one unfinished dish for which you have ingredients. Choose Indestructible Honey Cake first if you still owe it to the Classy Woman, and keep it for tomorrow's hand-in.
If no unfinished dish has all its ingredients ready, skip cooking. You do not need to finish all recipes before continuing today's trip.
Next, reread The Magical Future for Wisdom. This is today's reading; Literacy Workbook was scheduled to finish on 21 September.
At Mt. Vulkano, clear The Wayward Shepherd. Collect the relic, Gold Beetle and Rusty Greatsword before returning.

steps.label: Reminder for later · no extra cooking today
steps.text: If the cooking trophy is still missing, note the dishes and ingredients you need.
items: If you cooked the Classy Woman's cake today, keep it for tomorrow's free hand-in and Lord of the Lake reward.

The next scheduled cooking opportunity is before reading on the 30 September Jin journey. If that journey moves to 3 October for the Basilio recovery, its cooking moves with it. You do not need to re-enter the dungeon or start another journey tonight.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Used by the dungeon.

steps.label: Free hand-ins · Grand Trad
steps.text: Complete these errands before your afternoon activity.
items: Sunshade Row → outside Spado Smithy: give the Rusty Greatsword from Mt. Vulkano to the Ornamented Man to complete The Edge of Glory.

Only if The Queen of Cuisine: Soul is still active and you have its cake: go to Sunlumeo Street → outside Nau Filono Tavern. Give Indestructible Honey Cake to the Classy Woman. Keep her Lord of the Lake reward for Sublime Spoonful.

steps.label: Free collection check · Arenafront Wharf, Brilehaven
steps.text: Visit the Elderly Entomophile and save before exchanging Gold Beetles.
items: To collect every reward, you need 46 Gold Beetles across this run's exchanges. Include beetles already traded this run when counting; you do not need 46 still in your bag.
If you have enough, collect the remaining rewards. If you are short, keep your remaining beetles and continue today's bond below.
Ongoing goal: four more pickups are scheduled in October, followed by another reward check on 20 October. The guide does not require you to reach 46 before leaving today.

steps.label: Afternoon · one bond · uses time
steps.text: Check Basilio's current follower rank.
items: Rank 6: take rank 7 today and accept its request.
Rank 5 after the Imagination or Eloquence recovery: take rank 6 today only if Imagination is at least 5. His rank 7 then moves to 30 September.
If Imagination is still below 5, preserve your save and stop before spending the afternoon; this branch needs revising for the remaining shortfall.
Reminder for later: rank 8 needs Eloquence 5. Follow the 2 October check, with 14 October reserved if that period is unavailable. You are not taking rank 8 today.

steps.label: Night · relic report
steps.text: Speak to Neuras and give him the Parquet Chest relic from Scoundrel's Hold. Complete the report and check that his follower rank reaches 6.

steps.label: Afternoon · choose one activity · uses time
steps.text: Check Bardon's current follower rank.
items: Bardon is rank 7 after completing his quest: take his rank-8 event in Martira today. This uses the afternoon.

His rank-7 battle is still unfinished: leave it for 16 October, followed by rank 8 on 18 October. Use today's afternoon for a virtue instead: if Wisdom is below 5, sit on the bench on Grand Trad's Sunlumeo Street; otherwise listen to the Sanctor in Brilehaven's Angler's Inn Square for Imagination.
Complete only one afternoon activity, then keep the separate Neuras report for tonight. No extra Bardon battle or rank-up is required today.

steps.label: Night · relic report and request
steps.text: Speak to Neuras and give him the relic from Mt. Vulkano. Complete the report, check that his follower rank reaches 7, and accept the resulting Petty Thief request.
items: Reminder for later: the trip to complete Petty Thief is scheduled for tomorrow, or 3 October if you need tomorrow for Basilio. Accepting the request tonight does not mean setting out immediately.

steps.label: Optional
steps.text: Check the weapon and armour sale.

steps.label: Free preparation · Grand Trad
steps.text: Speak to the guard near the Recruitment Centre to locate Jin's runner. Do this before today's main activity, even if the Basilio recovery below postpones the journey.

steps.label: Afternoon · choose one activity
steps.text: Check Basilio's follower rank before setting out.
items: Basilio is rank 6 after the 28 September recovery: stay in town and take his rank-7 event today. Skip the journey, cooking and reading in the rest of this step; they move together to 3 October. Continue with tonight's Junah event.
Otherwise, take the Jin journey today: select Jin's runner on the map. Follow the travel instructions below only if you are taking this trip.

During travel, optional cooking comes first: use Speed Cooking for one unfinished dish for which you have ingredients. If the other 20 dishes are complete, you can make Sublime Spoonful with 1 Lord of the Lake, 3 Queen's Honey Jars and 3 Gauntlet Shrooms. Skip cooking if you have the trophy or lack ingredients.
Next, reread The Magical Future for Wisdom. Defeat Jin at the encounter and watch the following event: Petty Thief completes and Neuras reaches rank 8 automatically. There is no extra city hand-in.
Return to town and follow tonight's Junah step.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: Find Junah through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 7.

steps.label: Afternoon · travel and dungeon
steps.text: Before leaving Grand Trad, check that The Apostles of the Apocalypse is active. Set the runner route to Disgraced Ruins.
items: During travel, reread The Magical Future for Wisdom. Collect the Malibelo Stope drawing when the route event appears.
Inside Disgraced Ruins, take the left branch from the entrance to its dead end for the Gold Beetle. Clear the bounty target before returning.

Free check after travelling: note your current Wisdom rank. You do not have to raise it to 5 inside this dungeon. Wisdom 5 is the requirement for Eupha’s town event on 5 October; that entry has an alternative if you are still short.

steps.label: Ongoing training goal · optional during this outing
steps.text: If you want more A-EXP, this dungeon has repeatable enemies. Use it toward your remaining study prerequisites or More’s current task. No new Archetype rank is required just to finish today’s bounty and return.
items: Keep a separate save before the coming optional challenges. Continue tracking unfinished training for its later unlocks and trophy requirements; this is not a claim that every build needs the same amount of preparation.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Used by the dungeon. Return and rest.

steps.label: Free hand-in · Grand Trad
steps.text: Go to Regalith Grand Cathedral → Recruitment Centre. Speak to the Recruiter Dispatcher behind the counter and claim The Apostles of the Apocalypse reward for Cistus. Complete this before the afternoon activity.

steps.label: Afternoon · choose one activity
steps.text: Open Followers and check Hulkenberg’s and Basilio’s current ranks. Use the first applicable option below.
items: Hulkenberg still needs her town rank 7: take that event today if Wisdom is at least 4. Her travelling rank 8 is reserved for 6 October. If Wisdom is short, use the bench on Grand Trad’s Sunlumeo Street instead and check the resulting rank.

Otherwise, Basilio is rank 7 and Eloquence is 5: take his quest-marked town event. Keep him in the active party for the Vinca fight. The event completes A Brother’s Mercy and his rank 8; confirm rank 8 in Followers afterwards.

If Basilio’s event is blocked by Eloquence, give a speech at Altabury’s Upper Blue Sky Bridge podium instead, then check the resulting rank. If neither a missing virtue nor the listed prerequisite explains the unavailable event, keep the save and leave the event pending.

Reminder for later: 14 October afternoon remains reserved for Basilio if you could not finish him today. Do not try to fit his event into the afternoon already spent on Hulkenberg or a virtue activity.

steps.label: Night · choose one bond event
steps.text: If Heismay still needs his town rank 7 and Imagination is at least 4, take that event tonight. His travelling rank 8 is reserved for 6 October.
items: Otherwise, take Brigitta’s next available nighttime event. At rank 6 she needs Courage 4 for rank 7; at rank 7, take her rank-8 event when available.

Reminder for later: unfinished Brigitta events have reservations on 14 and 16 October. Keep a full day between rank-up events. A missing Heismay prerequisite remains unfinished; the date alone does not complete it.

steps.label: Afternoon · choose one outing
steps.text: If Petty Thief was postponed from 30 September, do the Jin trip below. Otherwise go to the Coliseum at Brilehaven’s Arenafront Wharf and win your next ranked match.
items: Jin trip only: speak to the guard outside Grand Trad’s Recruitment Centre in Regalith Grand Cathedral to mark Jin’s runner. Select it on the runner map.

During that trip, use Speed Cooking for one unfinished dish if you have its ingredients, then reread The Magical Future for Wisdom. Defeat Jin to finish Petty Thief and Neuras’s final bond. Return to town for tonight’s activity.

Reminder for later: if you took the Jin trip, the arena match remains unfinished. Use the later October arena periods and the receptionist’s actual ranked ladder; certification and endurance Gauntlets do not count as ranked wins.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: Open Followers and select Catherina’s available bond event. If she is rank 7, this finishes rank 8. If an earlier event is still pending, complete that event instead and record the rank you reach; do not mark rank 8 until the menu shows it.

steps.label: Free check · ongoing Archetype goals
steps.text: Open the study menu and Followers to note which unlocks and prerequisites remain. This step asks you to record what is missing, not to start another dungeon or finish every mastery tonight.
items: Eupha’s final events are scheduled for 5 and 7 October, so some unlocks can still be unavailable today.

More's final tasks: Chapter Five needs 25 different Archetypes studied across the party (rank 7). Chapter Six: The End needs any one Elite Archetype at rank 20 (rank 8). More rank 8 is required for the all-followers trophy. The quickest candidate is usually Hulkenberg's Paladin, which the party guide already has her using. Elemental Master on the protagonist also counts; it needs Wizard 20 and Gallica rank 8. Report each task in Akademeia as soon as it is done; reporting is free.

Ongoing trophy goal: train each required protagonist Archetype to rank 20 over the remaining battles. Completing every other character’s tree is optional. Continue checking the prerequisites of the particular Archetype you want to use.

steps.label: Afternoon · travel and dungeon
steps.text: Check Proof of Power and Trial of the Dragon: Bygone Legacy are active, then depart from Altabury for Tower of Insolence. Save in a separate slot before leaving.
items: Reread The Magical Future during travel. Watch for the Decaying Estate drawing and check your Key Items after the route event. Game Rant and PSNProfiles both place it on the route to Tower of Insolence; this is the route's first scheduled trip.
In the tower, climb the first set of stairs and check the second floor beside the central railing for the Gold Beetle.
Defeat Ziocropos and collect the Bramblethorn Baton for Proof of Power. The dragon trial is a separate encounter above this ordinary boss.

steps.label: Free checks after the route event
steps.text: Note your Wisdom rank. Eupha needs Wisdom 5 for tomorrow’s town event; if you are still at 4, leave her event pending and use tomorrow’s Wisdom alternative. You do not need to stop this dungeon to reach Wisdom 5.
items: If Decaying Estate did not appear, check whether you already gave that drawing to Maria or already have Vista Viewer. Giving Maria drawings awards rewards, but is not required for the trophy.

If both the drawing and trophy are missing, recover it today: reload the save from before this trip and travel to Tower of Insolence again, watching for the route event. Do not leave it for a later date. PSNProfiles warns that some drawings become unobtainable once the story changes how you travel, and from 8 October the route may no longer be offered. 6 and 7 October are already used by the Abandoned Path journey.

steps.label: Today’s tower trial · attempt when prepared
steps.text: After the ordinary boss, the separate dragon trial is above it. It caps maximum HP at 300 and reflects ordinary damage types. Use Almighty damage or a confirmed method of bypassing resistance or creating a weakness, with healing and Hex protection or cures.
items: If your team is not ready, keep the ordinary quest completion and leave the trial unfinished for a recovery outing. Postponing this trial does not complete it; record that another dungeon day will be needed.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Used by the dungeon. Return and rest.

steps.label: Free hand-in · Opera House Square, Altabury
steps.text: Give the Bramblethorn Baton to the Obsessive Soldier in the southwest, near the arrival stairs, to complete Proof of Power.

steps.label: Afternoon · choose one activity
steps.text: Check Wisdom and Eupha’s quest before spending time.
items: Wisdom 5 and The Wayward Shepherd complete: select Eupha through Followers and take her rank-7 town event today.
Wisdom below 5: leave that event pending. Travel from Virga Island to Silento, read The Magical Future for Wisdom, and return to town after the village stop. Check the resulting rank.

Reminder for later if you took the Wisdom trip: her replacement town event is reserved for 17 October afternoon, followed by her travelling rank 8 on 19 October afternoon. They are separate activities with a full day between them. Use available travel periods for further Wisdom if still needed; the reservation does not guarantee you have reached 5.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: Find Junah through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 8.

steps.label: Afternoon · travel and one main activity
steps.text: From Altabury, chart the two-day route to Abandoned Path. Check The Incarnate in the Woods is active before leaving.
items: If Hulkenberg is rank 7 and her event is available, take her travelling rank-8 event today.
Otherwise, read The Magical Future or choose one Wisdom activity while Wisdom is below 5. If Wisdom is already 5, read an unfinished book instead.
A missing Hulkenberg town rank 7 cannot be completed during this journey. Leave both events recorded as unfinished; the recovery note below explains the later order.

steps.label: Night · optional cooking, then one main activity
steps.text: If the cooking trophy is unfinished, check the kitchen first. With Speed Cooking and the ingredients, make one unfinished dish before choosing tonight’s main activity. Skip cooking if you cannot make a dish. Sublime Spoonful unlocks only after the other recipes are cooked.
items: Main activity: if Heismay is rank 7 and his travelling event is available, take rank 8 tonight. This requires his town rank 7 to have been completed already, such as on 2 October.
Otherwise, choose one unfinished book or needed virtue activity. If his town rank 7 is missing, record it for a later town period; you cannot do it aboard tonight.

steps.label: Reminder for later · delayed bonds
steps.text: If Hulkenberg or Heismay still lacks town rank 7, note two unfinished events: town rank 7 first, then travelling rank 8 after a full intervening day. There is no additional bond activity to do tonight after the one above.
items: The planned recovery was the town event on 2 October followed by today’s travelling event. If that did not happen, the 14 and 16 October periods are usually taken by Basilio, Brigitta and Bardon, so plan on 20 October afternoon for the town rank 7 (or 21 October if the cooking plan needs the 20th). Take the travelling rank 8 as the main activity of the 22 or 23 October journey.

If both Hulkenberg and Heismay are delayed, give the second town event the other of 20 or 21 October afternoon, and the second travelling event the other of 22 or 23 October. Check that each event has its own period; skip optional cooking trips before skipping a bond.

steps.label: Afternoon · travel, then dungeon
steps.text: During the journey to Abandoned Path, do any cooking first, then choose one main travelling activity. Clear the dungeon after arrival.
items: Optional cooking: with Speed Cooking and the ingredients, make one unfinished dish. If the other 20 dishes are complete, Sublime Spoonful needs 1 Lord of the Lake, 3 Queen’s Honey Jars and 3 Gauntlet Shrooms. Skip cooking if you cannot make a dish.

Main travelling activity: if Eupha reached rank 7 on 5 October, take her travelling rank-8 event. Otherwise choose one Wisdom activity or an unfinished book. Her delayed rank-7 and rank-8 events remain reserved for 17 and 19 October.
Dungeon: defeat the four marked Rigopetias to bring out Ordemos, then defeat Ordemos to clear the bounty. Collect the Gold Beetle at the far north of the map before returning.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Used by the dungeon. Return and rest.

steps.label: Free check · unfinished bonds
steps.text: Open Followers and note any of the 14 followers who are still below rank 8. You are only checking the menu here; today’s dungeon has already used the night.
items: Ongoing goal for the recovery dates: complete missing town events and then their later travelling events before using spare days for optional grinding. The date alone does not mean every bond is finished.

More is the exception: he ranks up only through his Akademeia task reports, not Followers events. Check his current task now. If Chapter Six (one Elite Archetype at rank 20) is unfinished, train that Archetype in every remaining dungeon and report it by 24 October.

steps.label: Free hand-in · Grand Trad
steps.text: Visit Regalith Grand Cathedral → Recruitment Centre. Give Ordemos’s Bloodstained Talon to the Recruiter Dispatcher and claim The Incarnate in the Woods reward.

steps.label: Afternoon · dungeon outing
steps.text: Clear the Skybound Avatar main objective. You can return afterwards and continue the remaining October free days. Keep a separate save before the outing and follow the quest log.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Used by the dungeon.

steps.label: Afternoon · travel and dungeon
steps.text: Check The Cockatrice in the Clouds is active. Depart from Brilehaven for Manor of the Ascendant. During travel, choose one available travelling bond, Wisdom activity or unfinished book.
items: In the dungeon, climb to the second floor, then follow the left-hand route to the crawlspace. Enter the side room near the ladder and collect its Gold Beetle.
Defeat Kokamordos and return to town. This dungeon outing also uses tonight; do not plan another town activity afterwards.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Used by the dungeon. Return and rest.

steps.label: Free hand-in · Grand Trad
steps.text: Visit Regalith Grand Cathedral → Recruitment Centre. Speak to the Recruiter Dispatcher and claim The Cockatrice in the Clouds reward for Kokamordos.

steps.label: Afternoon · dungeon outing
steps.text: Revisit Forsaken Tower for Trial of the Dragon: Mad Mischief. Prepare your equipment before departing.
items: Check every active member’s equipment. This dragon can gain extra turns when your party blocks or repels its attacks. Remove unsuitable null/repel gear, including protection earned in the first tower trial.
During travel, optionally make one unfinished dish with Speed Cooking if you have the ingredients. Then choose one travelling bond, Wisdom activity or unfinished book before entering the dungeon.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Used by the dungeon. Return and rest.

steps.label: Afternoon · dungeon outing
steps.text: Revisit Spire of Blind Faith for Trial of the Dragon: Heroes' Rest. Complete the preparation below before leaving town.
items: If your chosen equipment needs a mask or vessel, check the experiment menu in Akademeia and buy the missing materials it lists. Shop stock can vary by weekday. This is preparation for the build you are using, not a requirement to finish every experiment today.
Prepare Fire protection for the 9,999-damage attack, plus protection or cures for Charm. Rewards from the earlier two trials help; guarding alone does not solve the Fire attack.

During travel, optionally use Speed Cooking for one unfinished dish if you have the ingredients. Then choose one available travelling bond, book or virtue activity. Skip cooking if the trophy is complete or supplies are missing.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Used by the dungeon. Return and rest; there is no extra town-shopping slot after this outing.

steps.label: Required check before today’s departure
steps.text: Open the quest log. All three Trial of the Dragon requests must be complete, and Trial of the Dragon: Essence of Power must have appeared, before taking today’s planned outing.
items: Each earlier trial completes when its boss is defeated; you do not need to report it to a requester.
If a trial is still unfinished, the follow-up outing below is not ready. Keep it pending while you finish that missing trial on a recovery outing; do not try to treat several dungeons as one day.

steps.label: Afternoon · dungeon outing
steps.text: Save separately and visit Dragon Temple. Use its unlocked lift/teleport route to the deepest Magla Hollow and the follow-up chamber. Remove equipment that Repels or Drains/Absorbs attacks before the fight. One guide names this route Divine Altar Path. Guides describe a party-wiping attack differently (after about 24 turns, or soon after the boss is nearly defeated), so bring enough damage to finish the fight rather than outlast it. If your party needs more preparation, use a later recovery day.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Used by the dungeon. The follow-up request completes on victory; return and rest without searching for a separate hand-in.

steps.label: Afternoon · choose one activity
steps.text: Go to Brilehaven → Arenafront Wharf → Varmareno Coliseum and check the Spirited Receptionist’s ranked ladder.
items: If any of the nine ranked matches remain, win the next match she offers today.
If all nine are won and Become Champion of the Coliseum is unfinished, take the Champion Battle instead.
If both are finished, use this afternoon for one available unfinished town event. Do not repeat a match to match an expected rank in the guide.

steps.label: Night · choose one activity
steps.text: Use the first applicable option below. Each option spends tonight’s main activity.
items: Eupha is delayed and Wisdom is below 5: watch The Princess Predicament at Altabury’s Opera House, then check the resulting Wisdom rank.
Otherwise, Alonzo has an available unfinished rank-7 or rank-8 event: take that event. Rank 7 requires Courage 5; rank 8 is with Daturam.
Otherwise, take the next unfinished arena event. Use the actual ranked wins you have completed, including replacement matches from earlier dates.

Arena option · choose one event at Brilehaven → Arenafront Wharf → Varmareno Coliseum. First, win the next ranked match offered by the Spirited Receptionist. Once Gold I is won, accept Become Champion of the Coliseum and take her Champion Battle; Bronze and Silver Gauntlets are not prerequisites. After those are finished, ask the Taciturn Receptionist for Gauntlet Challenge → Gold: The Furthest Reaches and win its 30 consecutive fights. Do only the first unfinished event available tonight; each uses a separate period.
Reminder for later: leave the unchosen events unfinished for the remaining October nights. A championship win and the Gold endurance challenge are separate from ranked wins.

steps.label: Recovery day · one activity in each period
steps.text: Check the two reservations below before spending today’s free time. Use a reserved period for a different task only if its named event is already complete.
items: Afternoon: if Basilio’s rank-8 quest event is still unfinished, take it with Basilio at rank 7 and Eloquence at 5. If either requirement is missing, keep the event pending; this date does not waive it.
Night: take Brigitta’s next available event. If she still needs rank 7, check Courage 4 and take rank 7 tonight. If rank 7 is already complete and rank 8 is available, take rank 8 instead.
Reminder for later: if you took Brigitta rank 7 tonight, her rank 8 is reserved for 16 October night. Do not attempt both ranks tonight.

steps.label: Afternoon · choose one activity
steps.text: Go to Varmareno Coliseum in Brilehaven’s Arenafront Wharf and check the Spirited Receptionist’s actual ranked ladder.
items: If a ranked match remains, win the next unfinished match today. After winning Gold I, accept Become Champion of the Coliseum, but leave its battle for another period.
If Gold I was already won before this afternoon, take the Champion Battle today if it is unfinished. Otherwise use this period for one available unfinished town event.
Certification and endurance Gauntlets do not count as the nine ranked wins. Use your actual victories, not an expected calendar rank.

steps.label: Night · choose one activity
steps.text: Use the first applicable option below.
items: Alonzo has an available unfinished rank-7 or rank-8 event: take it tonight. Rank 7 requires Courage 5; rank 8 is with Daturam after a full intervening day.
Alonzo still needs rank 7 but Courage is below 5: watch The King and The Knight’s of the Dinner Table at Altabury’s Opera House instead, then check your Courage rank.
Otherwise, take the next unfinished arena event. Count the ranked matches you have actually won, including replacement matches.

Arena option · choose one event at Brilehaven → Arenafront Wharf → Varmareno Coliseum. First, win the next ranked match offered by the Spirited Receptionist. Once Gold I is won, accept Become Champion of the Coliseum and take her Champion Battle; Bronze and Silver Gauntlets are not prerequisites. After those are finished, ask the Taciturn Receptionist for Gauntlet Challenge → Gold: The Furthest Reaches and win its 30 consecutive fights. Do only the first unfinished event available tonight; each uses a separate period.

Reminder for later: if tonight’s opera raises Courage to 5, reserve Alonzo rank 7 for 17 October and rank 8 for 19 October. If Courage is still short, you need another activity and revised reservations; do not assume those two events are ready.

steps.label: Ongoing combat goals · no extra outing today
steps.text: Keep these counters in mind during later battles. The Synthesis trophy needs 50 different skills used, so repeating one skill 50 times does not finish it.
items: The money-attack trophy needs at least 100,000 reeve spent through skills in total. Ten attacks costing 9,999 each leave you 10 reeve short. These are cumulative goals, not instructions to start a new grind tonight.

steps.label: Recovery day · one activity in each period
steps.text: Follow the afternoon choice, then the night choice below.
items: Afternoon: if Bardon’s rank-7 battle was postponed, take his bond event and complete The Right to Rule. If that chain is already complete, use this afternoon for one other unfinished town bond.
Reminder for later: after Bardon rank 7 today, keep 18 October afternoon for his rank 8.
Night: if Brigitta reached rank 7 on 14 October, finish her rank 8 tonight. Otherwise take the next unfinished arena event. If weather closes the arena, leave the event pending.

Arena option · choose one event at Brilehaven → Arenafront Wharf → Varmareno Coliseum. First, win the next ranked match offered by the Spirited Receptionist. Once Gold I is won, accept Become Champion of the Coliseum and take her Champion Battle; Bronze and Silver Gauntlets are not prerequisites. After those are finished, ask the Taciturn Receptionist for Gauntlet Challenge → Gold: The Furthest Reaches and win its 30 consecutive fights. Do only the first unfinished event available tonight; each uses a separate period.

steps.label: Recovery day · check both periods before choosing an outing
steps.text: Keep the afternoon and night reservations below unless their events are already finished.
items: Afternoon: if Eupha’s town rank 7 was delayed on 5 October, take it today with Wisdom 5 and The Wayward Shepherd complete. If the requirement is still missing, keep the save and record the extra recovery needed; the reservation does not make the event available.

If Eupha’s bond is already finished, use the afternoon for one other unfinished town bond. You may choose a delayed dungeon instead only if tonight has no reserved event left; a dungeon also uses the night.
Night, only if you stayed in town: take Alonzo’s next available event if it is unfinished and the required gap has passed. Otherwise take the next unfinished arena event.

Arena option · choose one event at Brilehaven → Arenafront Wharf → Varmareno Coliseum. First, win the next ranked match offered by the Spirited Receptionist. Once Gold I is won, accept Become Champion of the Coliseum and take her Champion Battle; Bronze and Silver Gauntlets are not prerequisites. After those are finished, ask the Taciturn Receptionist for Gauntlet Challenge → Gold: The Furthest Reaches and win its 30 consecutive fights. Do only the first unfinished event available tonight; each uses a separate period.
Reminder for later: if you completed Eupha rank 7 today, her travelling rank 8 is reserved for the 19 October journey.

steps.label: Free preparation today · unfinished cooking
steps.text: Open the kitchen recipe list and note which dishes you still need. Buy their missing ingredients before today’s bond event. This step is shopping and planning; keep today’s afternoon free for the bond below.
items: Ingredient check: Sublime Spoonful unlocks after the other 20 dishes. Reserve 1 Lord of the Lake, 3 Queen’s Honey Jars and 3 Gauntlet Shrooms for it. Add 1 honey jar for each unfinished Amber Stew or Adamantine Honey Cake. Also count the fish needed for unfinished Secretest of Secrets or Enchanted Pottage.

Shopping today: Comfort Concoctions on Grand Trad’s Sunshade Row sells Lumibees and Dreameater Moths. Krozelli the Hunter at Virga Island’s Dragon Statue Plaza sells monster ingredients. Amblyrhy’s Water Jug on Sandy Coast has 2 honey jars in total; buy remaining stock only if you need it. Check the runner pantry for random shrooms and reserve 3 for Sublime Spoonful.

Plan for 20 October onward, if you already have Tail Bait: travel from Virga Island to Silento on 20 October and fish. Use the catch for cooking on the next journey. Keep today’s Bardon event and the 19 October Eupha journey first.

Plan for 20 October onward, if you lack Tail Bait: clean the storage room during the 20 October trip, fish on 21 October, then cook on 22 October. Cleaning and fishing each use one main travel activity; they cannot share the same period.

Reference for the cleaning day: save before cleaning. The reward is random. If you do not receive 2 Tail Bait, reload and retry or leave the bait requirement unfinished. Do not continue the plan assuming you received it.

Reference for the fishing day: check whether the deck’s fishing point is available. Bad sea weather can close it; keep the save from before departure and check Edeni’s weather options if needed. With Tail Bait, choose queasy → “Think like a fish”; tired → “Give in to naptime”; nothing biting → “Thrash and splash”. A successful catch gives 1 Lord of the Lake and 2 honey jars.

If you need a second catch, reserve another sea journey before the final cooking journey, such as fishing on 22 October and cooking on 23 October. Recount ingredients after each catch. Speed Cooking lets you make one dish before a main activity in each travel period; it does not finish several missing dishes at once.

steps.label: Recovery day · one activity in each period
steps.text: Finish the free shopping above first, then follow these choices.
items: Afternoon: if Bardon reached rank 7 on 16 October, take his town rank-8 event. If his bond is finished, use this period for one other unfinished town bond.

Night: first finish any free Daturam follow-up available from an Alonzo rank-8 event completed on an earlier night. Then take a still-reserved Brigitta event if one needs tonight; otherwise take the next unfinished arena event.

Arena option · choose one event at Brilehaven → Arenafront Wharf → Varmareno Coliseum. First, win the next ranked match offered by the Spirited Receptionist. Once Gold I is won, accept Become Champion of the Coliseum and take her Champion Battle; Bronze and Silver Gauntlets are not prerequisites. After those are finished, ask the Taciturn Receptionist for Gauntlet Challenge → Gold: The Furthest Reaches and win its 30 consecutive fights. Do only the first unfinished event available tonight; each uses a separate period.

steps.label: Recovery day · free hand-ins first
steps.text: Report any completed requests and bounties before spending time. Then follow today’s afternoon and night choices.
items: Afternoon: if Eupha reached rank 7 on 17 October, travel from Virga Island to Silento and take her travelling rank-8 event. Return to town after the village stop.

If Eupha’s bond is already complete, use that journey for one other available travelling bond, an unfinished book or one main activity from the cooking-recovery plan. Do not add fishing or cleaning after a bond event in the same travel period.
Night: if Alonzo reached rank 7 on 17 October, complete his rank 8 tonight. Otherwise take the next unfinished arena event. This night activity is separate from the afternoon journey.

Arena option · choose one event at Brilehaven → Arenafront Wharf → Varmareno Coliseum. First, win the next ranked match offered by the Spirited Receptionist. Once Gold I is won, accept Become Champion of the Coliseum and take her Champion Battle; Bronze and Silver Gauntlets are not prerequisites. After those are finished, ask the Taciturn Receptionist for Gauntlet Challenge → Gold: The Furthest Reaches and win its 30 consecutive fights. Do only the first unfinished event available tonight; each uses a separate period.

steps.label: Free trophy check before spending time
steps.text: If Blessed Power is missing, take eligible equipment to St. Fermis Church in Grand Trad's Sunlumeo Street and pay to purify one item. If Shrewd Shopper is missing, buy one item visibly marked as discounted today; dates ending in 0 or 5 are Idlesday. Check the console trophy list after each action.

steps.label: Free collection reward · Arenafront Wharf, Brilehaven
steps.text: If All That Glitters is still missing, return to the Elderly Entomophile after the October dungeon pickups. Finish his exchanges once beetles held plus beetles exchanged this run reach 46. Count the exchanges already made; do not demand 46 still held after trading. Save first. If the total is short, keep unspent beetles for further pickups or New Game Plus rather than assuming this checklist proves completion.

steps.label: Recovery day · make today’s plan before spending time
steps.text: Check the bookshelf, kitchen records, Followers and trophy list against these targets: all seven books Finished, 21 different dishes cooked, all 14 followers at rank 8, all five villages visited and Vista Viewer earned. Record what is unfinished. Complete the free checks below, including any beetle exchange, before leaving town.
items: Afternoon, if cooking ingredients are missing: use the 18 October plan. Travel from Virga Island to Silento and choose one main activity: fish if you already have Tail Bait, or clean the storage room if you still need it. Return to town after the village stop. Cooking the resulting dish belongs to a later journey. If you do not need this ingredient trip, use the afternoon for one available unfinished bond or request; the route leaves this period free for that purpose.

Night · choose one main activity: first finish any free Daturam follow-up available from an Alonzo rank-8 event completed on an earlier night. Then take the next arena event described below. If the arena is closed, leave that event unfinished and use a later free arena period. If all arena events are complete, use tonight for another available unfinished event.

Arena option · choose one event at Brilehaven → Arenafront Wharf → Varmareno Coliseum. First, win the next ranked match offered by the Spirited Receptionist. Once Gold I is won, accept Become Champion of the Coliseum and take her Champion Battle; Bronze and Silver Gauntlets are not prerequisites. After those are finished, ask the Taciturn Receptionist for Gauntlet Challenge → Gold: The Furthest Reaches and win its 30 consecutive fights. Do only the first unfinished event available tonight; each uses a separate period.

steps.label: Free check · remaining map locations
steps.text: Check which of Komero, Inundo, Silento, Ligno and Malva you have visited. Also check the map locations revealed by candidate conversations and their runner encounters.
items: Record any missing location for an available journey. This is a checklist of places, not an instruction to visit all five villages today. Keep any required journey separate from the main activities already chosen above.

steps.label: Recovery day · free preparation first
steps.text: In Akademeia, check unfinished experiments and make any whose materials you have and can afford. Note missing materials for later; this does not require completing every experiment before today’s departure.
items: Afternoon, if following the cooking-recovery plan: travel from Virga Island to Silento. If you cleaned yesterday and now have Tail Bait, use the main activity to fish. If you already caught the ingredients, use Speed Cooking for one unfinished dish before choosing one main travel activity. Return to town after the village stop.
If you need no journey, use the afternoon for one available unfinished bond or request.

Night · choose one main activity: first finish any free Daturam follow-up available from an Alonzo rank-8 event completed on an earlier night. Then take the next arena event described below. If the arena is closed, leave that event unfinished and use a later free arena period. If all arena events are complete, use tonight for another available unfinished event.

Arena option · choose one event at Brilehaven → Arenafront Wharf → Varmareno Coliseum. First, win the next ranked match offered by the Spirited Receptionist. Once Gold I is won, accept Become Champion of the Coliseum and take her Champion Battle; Bronze and Silver Gauntlets are not prerequisites. After those are finished, ask the Taciturn Receptionist for Gauntlet Challenge → Gold: The Furthest Reaches and win its 30 consecutive fights. Do only the first unfinished event available tonight; each uses a separate period.
Ongoing goals: keep More’s unfinished tasks and the protagonist’s missing rank-20 masteries recorded for the remaining battles. These are not extra training tasks to complete tonight after the arena.

steps.label: Recovery day · choose one afternoon plan
steps.text: If cooking is still unfinished, use the next journey in the recovery sequence. Otherwise prioritise an available unfinished follower event or request. Leave optional combat grinding until calendar-dependent work is accounted for.
items: Night · choose one main activity: first finish any free Daturam follow-up available from an Alonzo rank-8 event completed on an earlier night. Then take the next arena event described below. If the arena is closed, leave that event unfinished and use a later free arena period. If all arena events are complete, use tonight for another available unfinished event.

Arena option · choose one event at Brilehaven → Arenafront Wharf → Varmareno Coliseum. First, win the next ranked match offered by the Spirited Receptionist. Once Gold I is won, accept Become Champion of the Coliseum and take her Champion Battle; Bronze and Silver Gauntlets are not prerequisites. After those are finished, ask the Taciturn Receptionist for Gauntlet Challenge → Gold: The Furthest Reaches and win its 30 consecutive fights. Do only the first unfinished event available tonight; each uses a separate period.
