Alternative night activity, only if the arena work is already complete: if At Your Own Risk is still locked, save and visit the Spirited Youth at the northwestern ledge in Martira’s Thoroughfare Square. With Courage 3 or higher, take the jump he offers: 250 or 375 reeve means an earlier jump, while 500 reeve means the final super-fine rope. After an earlier jump, his price on the next visit confirms success; after the final jump, check the trophy. Reload on failure. Do only one jump tonight. Keep any remaining jump for 24 October night if that period is free; each unfinished jump needs a separate period.

Ongoing combat checklist: 50 different Synthesis skills used; 100 squad ambushes after a field stun; 50 unscathed battle wins; 10 Elementas defeated; 100,000 reeve spent through skills; one successful steal; Gallica conversations; and sword-riding distance. Review what is missing and work on it during suitable battles or free exploration. This list is not an instruction to finish every counter today. Instant field kills do not count as squad ambushes.

steps.label: Recovery day · choose one unfinished objective
steps.text: Use today for a missing request (including any unreported Neuras relic search), drawing journey, trial or available follower event. Do not rely on today for Decaying Estate: its recovery belongs on 4 October, before the story changes how you travel. If a drawing is still missing, check that its route is still offered before departing.
items: If you choose a dungeon, that outing uses both afternoon and night. Do not plan another nighttime activity after it.

If several trials remain, record each as its own outing and leave a separate day for their follow-up. Do not replace needed calendar activities with grinding. If the remaining outings no longer fit, keep the older save rather than treating this one recovery day as enough for all of them.

steps.label: Last-chance check · free, before spending time
steps.text: After 25 October the story moves into the final area and you cannot return to towns, travel, the arena or follower events this run. Confirm in the menus now: all 14 followers at rank 8 (including More through his Akademeia tasks), every request complete, every book finished, beetle exchanges done and missing crafting materials bought. Use today and tomorrow afternoon for anything missing: bonds and requests first, then trophies with counters.

steps.label: Recovery day · plan each period separately
steps.text: Use the afternoon for one remaining activity that needs free time. Tomorrow afternoon is also available for an eligible final preparation, but tomorrow night is reserved for farewell visits. Keep an older save if you are unsure a requirement is complete.
items: Night · choose one main activity: first finish any free Daturam follow-up available from an Alonzo rank-8 event completed on an earlier night. Then take the next arena event described below. If the arena is closed, keep your save and check whether tomorrow afternoon can accommodate it; do not assume another normal evening remains. If all arena events are complete, use tonight for another available unfinished event.

Arena option · choose one event at Brilehaven → Arenafront Wharf → Varmareno Coliseum. First, win the next ranked match offered by the Spirited Receptionist. Once Gold I is won, accept Become Champion of the Coliseum and take her Champion Battle; Bronze and Silver Gauntlets are not prerequisites. After those are finished, ask the Taciturn Receptionist for Gauntlet Challenge → Gold: The Furthest Reaches and win its 30 consecutive fights. Do only the first unfinished event available tonight; each uses a separate period.

Alternative night activity, only after arena work is complete: if At Your Own Risk is still locked, save and visit the Spirited Youth at the northwestern ledge in Martira’s Thoroughfare Square. With Courage 3 or higher, take the offered jump: 250 or 375 reeve means an earlier jump, while 500 reeve means the final super-fine rope. After an earlier jump, his price on the next visit confirms success; after the final jump, check the trophy. Reload on failure. This uses tonight’s activity. If another jump remains, use tomorrow afternoon for it. One guide lists this trophy as missable, so do not leave it for New Game Plus. One period completes one jump.

steps.label: Afternoon · final preparation
steps.text: Do any free equipment, inventory or accessible runner-facility checks first. If you still need an available activity that spends time, choose one for this afternoon. Keep tonight for the farewell visits below.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Visit your maxed followers for their farewell items. Gallica can help you travel between them. Save separately before resting.

steps.label: Before entering
steps.text: Keep a permanent pre-finale save. Read this entry fully before fighting optional bosses in the final area.

steps.label: Trophy route
steps.text: Leave every optional boss in the final area undefeated and go to the final main objective. Do not take side lifts or teleport circles off the main route; they lead to optional fights. If one starts, reload rather than winning it. Defeating the final boss at full strength is the condition for Star Shatterer. Do not weaken it first. Save near the end if the game permits it.

steps.label: Optional training in today’s final area
steps.text: If you need more preparation, fight regular enemies. On the last map, two tooth spawners keep producing enemies, which makes them the best place to finish the protagonist's remaining rank-20 masteries. Do not destroy them while you still need to train. Keep the optional bosses undefeated for the full-strength trophy route above. Keep the permanent pre-finale save while any first-run trophy checks remain unfinished.
items: Reminder for your return run: its exclusive challenge has equipment restrictions, including responses to gear that repels attacks. Check that fight’s advice when you reach it; this is not an extra fight to do today.

steps.label: After the required victory
steps.text: Confirm the story, full-strength and all-request trophies, then save the clear data separately. If you want to see skipped optional encounters, you may reload the pre-finale save afterwards; keep your clear data too.
